rows.observation: 标题“Antimagic User”中的“User”未在“反魔法”中体现；缺少标题用途语境，无法确定是否允许省略。
rows.conclusion: 固定主游戏 TooltipsData.lua:533–536 将 Antimagic User 用作特性标题；“反魔法”作为 UI 标题可表达该特性，正文已说明使用者的行为，省略 User 不造成事实缺失。

rows.observation: 原文的 damage%% 和 resistance penetration %% 各含一个转义百分号，译文两处均未保留百分号。
rows.conclusion: 固定主游戏 summon-melee.lua 的 damage%% 已译作“百分比伤害”；resistance penetration %% 是百分比属性而非必须逐字保留的运行时占位符。与第276批同一源串的已记录裁决一致。

rows.observation: 原文称饰物看似无害，直到透过其孔洞观看；译文改为“勿视其中，安然无恙”，漏掉饰物及孔洞，并将陈述改成劝诫。
rows.conclusion: 公开 Ashes world-artifacts.lua:716 的物品描述是“看似无害的饰物，直到透过孔洞观看”；现译改为劝诫，漏掉饰物、孔洞与转折。本批文件 SHA 匹配，来源仓库/commit 未固定。

rows.observation: 原文“pitch black”描述颜色，译文“黑曜石”将其改成了特定材质。
rows.conclusion: 公开 Ashes world-artifacts.lua:742 的 pitch black 只表示漆黑，现译“黑曜石”增添材质；同文件:715 另有 obsidian ring，二者不可混同。本批文件 SHA 匹配，来源仓库/commit 未固定。

rows.observation: 原文说腐化泰坦的攻击性不亚于较年轻的同类，译文却说“杀伤力”不小；原文“few Eyalites”也被泛化为“几乎无人”。
rows.conclusion: 公开 Ashes lore/demon.lua:342 的 no less aggressive 是攻击性不逊于年轻同类，few Eyalites would stand and fight 是少有埃亚尔人愿意迎战；现译误作杀伤力及几乎无人能近战，并漏掉改造后代。文件 SHA 匹配，来源仓库/commit 未固定。

rows.observation: 原文“Murderer”指杀人者，译文“屠戮”指杀戮行为。
rows.conclusion: 公开 Ashes overload/data/chats/ashes-urhrok-walrog-pop.lua:50–54 用 Murderer 代入“%s to the Naloren”句中；中文完整句以“屠戮纳鲁精灵”表达动作，不能孤立按名词判断。文件 SHA 匹配，来源仓库/commit 未固定。

rows.observation: 原文明确指目标的武器看起来威胁较小，译文却写成目标本身的危险度降低，误译了对象。
rows.conclusion: 公开 Ashes data/timed_effects.lua:51–52 的 Demon Blade 消失消息主语是 #Target# 的武器；现译写成角色本人威胁降低。文件 SHA 匹配，来源仓库/commit 未固定。

rows.observation: Traitor 是指人，译文“背叛”是行为，词义明显不符。
rows.conclusion: 公开 Ashes overload/data/chats/ashes-urhrok-walrog-pop.lua:50–54 用 Traitor 代入“%s to the Naloren”句中；中文完整句以“背叛乌克姆斯维克”表达动作，不能孤立按名词判断。文件 SHA 匹配，来源仓库/commit 未固定。

rows.observation: 原文写他们建立了许多黑暗教团，译文改为“通过黑暗仪式”，遗漏教团；原文的“ranged attackers”也未译出。
rows.conclusion: 公开 Ashes unlock-corrupter_demonologist.lua:21–36 的 created many dark cults 被误作“通过黑暗仪式”；ranged attackers 遗漏，原文单换行被加空行，恶魔之种/恶魔种子与堕落系/堕落者在同条不一致。文件 SHA 匹配，来源仓库/commit 未固定。

rows.observation: “Regen”表示再生或恢复，译文“吸收”改变了含义。
rows.conclusion: 公开 Ashes timed_effects.lua:523–530 的 Osmosis Regeneration、+/- Osmosis Regen 描述生命再生，现有同族译名统一为“渗透吸收”；是否更名须同步效果及日志，列为跨条名称决定。本批文件 SHA 匹配，来源仓库/commit 未固定。

rows.observation: 原文“Bind and use demons”中的“Bind”未在译文中体现；“do your bidding”也被限定为“作战”。
rows.conclusion: 公开 Ashes corruptions.lua:22 明写 Bind and use demons to do your bidding；现译只说驱使恶魔作战，漏掉束缚并把服从命令缩成作战。文件 SHA 匹配，来源仓库/commit 未固定。

rows.observation: world-artifacts.lua:742: 'pitch black' means extremely dark (漆黑), but the target renders it as 黑曜石 (obsidian). That adds a material the source does not state. The same file separately uses 'obsidian ring' at :715 for The Black Ring, so this translation mixes up two different unidentified names. Suggest 漆黑胸甲.
rows.conclusion: 公开 Ashes world-artifacts.lua:742 的 pitch black 只表示漆黑，现译“黑曜石”增添材质；同文件:715 另有 obsidian ring，二者不可混同。本批文件 SHA 匹配，来源仓库/commit 未固定。

rows.observation: demon.lua:342: 'Although no less aggressive than their younger counterparts' means titans are just as aggressive as the younger wretchlings. The target 不比酸液树魔杀伤力小 turns aggression into damage output, which changes the meaning, and it also drops 'younger counterparts'. Also, 'few Eyalites would stand and fight' is about Eyalites not being willing to fight; 几乎无人能站在他们面前肉搏 turns that into not being able to, and drops 'Eyalites'.
rows.conclusion: 公开 Ashes lore/demon.lua:342 的 no less aggressive 是攻击性不逊于年轻同类，few Eyalites would stand and fight 是少有埃亚尔人愿意迎战；现译误作杀伤力及几乎无人能近战，并漏掉改造后代。文件 SHA 匹配，来源仓库/commit 未固定。

rows.observation: timed_effects.lua:51-52: this is the on_lose message for Demon Blade. The source subject is the weapon ('#Target#'s weapon looks less threatening'), matching :51 where the effect puts demonic fire on the weapon. The target #Target#的危险度看起来降低了 drops 'weapon' and says the character looks less dangerous, which misstates where the effect was. Suggest #Target#的武器看起来没那么危险了.
rows.conclusion: 公开 Ashes data/timed_effects.lua:51–52 的 Demon Blade 消失消息主语是 #Target# 的武器；现译写成角色本人威胁降低。文件 SHA 匹配，来源仓库/commit 未固定。

rows.observation: unlock-corrupter_demonologist.lua:21-35 has four problems. (1) Line 22 'have created many dark cults' is translated as 通过黑暗仪式 (dark rituals): cults are not rituals, and the act of founding them is lost. (2) Lines 21-23 are separated by single newlines in the source, but the target adds a blank line after 双面间谍。 and after 恐慌。, which breaks the newline invariant. (3) The same text renders demonic seeds as both 恶魔之种 and 恶魔种子. (4) Corruptors is rendered as both 堕落系 and 堕落者, so terms are inconsistent within this one entry.
rows.conclusion: 公开 Ashes unlock-corrupter_demonologist.lua:21–36 的 created many dark cults 被误作“通过黑暗仪式”；ranged attackers 遗漏，原文单换行被加空行，恶魔之种/恶魔种子与堕落系/堕落者在同条不一致。文件 SHA 匹配，来源仓库/commit 未固定。
